pr_title: Improve the tasks error reporting when processed in batches
pr_body:
This fixes #2478 by changing the behavior of the task handler when there is an error in a batch of document addition or update.

What changes is that when there is a user error in a task in a batch we now report this task as failed with the right error message but we continue to process the other tasks. A user error can be when a geo field is invalid, a document id is invalid, or missing.

fixes #2582, #2478

issue_context.title: Auto-batching: improve error handler + make it available by default
issue_context.body:
## What is auto-batching?

The auto-batching feature is a feature we introduced in v0.26.0 to improve the indexation speed when users push their data in multiple small batches (ex: 100 batches of 1 document). Pushing the data in small batches instead of one big considerably impacts (negatively) the indexation speed.
That's why we released the auto-batching as an experimental feature: automatically regroup in one big batch the small batches of the users.

The auto-batching feature is currently present as experimental, meaning users have to activate it using `--enable-auto-batching` when launching the Meilisearch binary.

This discussion has been created to gather feedback: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/discussions/2070

We estimate this feature is necessary to increase the user experience by reducing the indexation time. We now want to provide it by default, I mean, not as an experimental feature anymore.

## Goal of the issue

This issue gathers the changes we need to make with the auto-batching feature in order to remove its "experimental" label:
- [x] Improve the error handler regarding the auto-batching feature: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2478
- [x] Update the settings related to the feature
  - [x] Auto-batching is activated by default. It involves the `--enable-auto-batching` flag being removed and replaced by `--disable-auto-batching`. An environment variable should also be added to handle this option (`MEILI_DISABLE_AUTO_BATCHING`)
  - [x] Remove all the current options: `--debounce-duration-sec`, `--max-batch-size` and `--max-documents-per-batch`. Discussed with @gmourier: these options do not seems impactful. We'll add these options (or equivalent) later if needed.

## Process

💫 This issue will be completed with links and all the necessary information all along the feature creation process

- [x] Apply changes above
- [X] Create the corresponding specification and link it to this issue -> https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/162
-----

Pinging @meilisearch/docs-team and @meilisearch/cloud-team
comments:
Hello,
Do you plan to add environment variables to disable/configure auto-batching?

Hello @nicolasvienot! Thanks for asking.

Checked with @gmourier:
- Fresh news: the current options to configure the auto batching (`--debounce-duration-sec`, `--max-batch-size` and `--max-documents-per-batch`) will be removed, so no env variable needed.
- we will add an env variable for the `--disable-auto-batching` flag. I've updated the issue 😊

Thanks @curquiza

Another question, is it something that we can expect one day to be configurable directly through the Meilisearch API, or does it requires relaunching Meilisearch?

What we expect one day (for v1 probably) is the autobatching feature to be totally transparent: nothing to configure, it works by default and you cannot disable it
If, for any reasons, we need to introduce additional configurations in the future, I don't know yet how it will be done. Doing the configuration via the API could be a solution I guess. @gmourier FYI.

FYI, I've just created the related spec: https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/162
I've just added it to this issue description.
FYI, the `batchUid` fields has been removed, see this issue: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2676

Hello everyone watching this issue!

We have just released [v0.29.0rc1](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/releases/tag/v0.29.0rc1), which is a release candidate of v0.29.0 🔥 
It means you can test the auto-batching working by default in this RC! [Binaries](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/releases/tag/v0.29.0rc1) are attached to the release, or you can use the docker image:
```bash
docker run -it --rm \
    -p 7700:7700 \
    getmeili/meilisearch:v0.29.0rc1
```

Let us know about any bugs or feedback! 😄 It would be really helpful.

FYI, the official v0.29.0 release will be available on 3rd October.
